notPages.reason: TeamPolicyBlock is a read-only rendering block (supervision line + boundary chips) embedded in the run Overview (run_screen.dart:775) only when `controller.policy != null`; no surface and no interactive element.

Shared helper (design standard §3, §4), not a page: teamScreenState/teamScreenLoading/teamScreenFailed/teamStatusLine render the AI Team screens' connecting/error/stale states and one status line; its retry buttons are recorded as elements of the host pages (team-home, team-run, team-agent, team-agents) with `file` set here.

Embedded blocks, not pages of their own: TeamNeedsYouCard (one question as a request block) is shown on team-home, where it is also its task's row, and on team-run-overview-tab (run_screen.dart:780); TeamGateRow (a question whose task is not listed) is a row of team-home's one list. Both open the Gate sheet.

Embedded moments, no surface and no interactive element (motion slice D, 2026-09-25): TeamMergedCelebration heads team-run-overview-tab (run_screen.dart), the first time a merged task is seen, remembered per profile under oc.orchestration.{profileId}.celebrated; TeamNeedsYouLabel is the 'Needs you' heading on team-home and team-run-overview-tab, with an agent that waves once. Both drawings are decorative (excluded from semantics).

Drawings (KitScene, design standard §10), not pages: the AI Team's cast (board, planning, waking, merged, nudge, rest, idle) shown on team-home (no tasks, Needs you, the planning card, the host starting), team-run-overview-tab, team-agents (no agents), embedded-team-card (Nothing running) and the in-app and Termux AI Team sections while the team starts.

The routing API for the task conversation, not a page of its own: TeamConversation.open/start push TeamConversationScreen (team-conversation, chat/team_conversation_view.dart). TeamTaskConversationRow (the Overview's 'Open conversation' row) is recorded as team-run-overview-open-conversation on team-run-overview-tab; TeamAgentTranscript and TeamOpenConversationRow are re-exports of chat/team_conversation_view.dart (see team-conversation's own elements and team-agent-output).

TeamPage/openTeamPage: the one AI Team route (P3.4). No surface of its own: it shows team-home while the connected server's team is on and team-intro while it is off, following the connection, plus a bare loading page for the frame between turning on and the team starting.

notes: Area visibility: the whole AI Team area hangs off `ConnectionController.orchestration` (lib/state/connection.dart:712). `_syncOrchestration` (connection.dart:746-770) builds the OrchestrationController only when the connected `ServerProfile.orchestration` config is non-null and `!isIsolated`. Entry points: TeamCard in WorkspaceScreen (workspace_screen.dart:619-625 -> _openTeamHome:854), team deep links/notifications (lib/main.dart:877-903), ActivityScreen gate / blocked-agent tiles (activity_screen.dart:861, 926) and the gate sheet (gate_sheet.dart:79, 88).

Two different classes are both named TeamReceiptChip: lib/ui/widgets/team_receipt.dart:101 (gate rows, `onOpen`) and lib/ui/widgets/team_controls.dart:51 (control receipts, `onRetry`). team_home_screen.dart and activity_screen.dart import the former; run_screen.dart, agent_screen.dart and team_cycle_strip.dart the latter.
team_cycle_strip.dart:345 shows a control TeamReceiptChip without onRetry (no button) while `receipt != null && !receipt.isSettled`; not interactive.
run_screen.dart _NeedsYouCard (1129) and agent_screen.dart _NeedsYou (key team-agent-gate, agent_screen.dart:325) are read-only: they say where to answer and have no tap target.

ProductErrorState 'Try again' / 'Report a bug' and ProductEmptyState's action button live in lib/ui/widgets/product_states.dart (area a-shell); recorded on the team pages with `file` set. openBugReport's target page is not resolved here.

Confirm sheets are rendered by showConfirmSheet (lib/ui/widgets/confirm_sheet.dart, area a-shell) via confirmTeamControl (team_controls.dart:275); the cancel label is always 'Keep going' (teamUiControlKeep); confirm buttons are destructive-styled.

TeamPlanningCard (start_run_sheet.dart:463), TeamMergeSection (merge_section.dart), WorkGraph (work_graph.dart), showWorkSheet, showGateSheet, showStartRunSheet and showTeamHostDetailsSheet belong to i2; referenced by targetWidget only. Target ids used: start-run-sheet, gate-sheet, work-sheet, team-host-details-sheet.
A TeamLinkKind.gate deep link goes to ActivityScreen(initialTeamGateId) (lib/main.dart:881-888), not to a team screen.

team-agents (team_agents_screen.dart) added for the aiteam-redesign-2026-09-24 merge; its RefreshIndicator (team_agents_screen.dart:177, onRefresh -> _refresh()) is left out of elements: unlike team-home/team-run/team-agent it has no app-bar Refresh icon-button, so pulling to refresh may be the only way to force a refresh outside of a stale/failed state. Flag for gesture-audit.md / a product decision rather than recording an unanswerable gesture-audit row.

team-home, team-run and team-agent's error/loading states are recorded elsewhere in this file with `file: lib/ui/widgets/product_states.dart` (ProductErrorState/ProductEmptyState); their code now goes through team_states.dart's teamScreenState instead (see its docstring: "they now come from here"). Left as recorded (not this task's scope); team-agents, added after that refactor, is recorded against team_states.dart directly.

team-board (team_board_screen.dart), added with the board (docs/design/team-board-2026-09-26.md): its KitRefresh.onRefresh -> _refresh() on every column (team_board_screen.dart:640) and on the empty state (line 519) is left out of elements for the same reason as team-agents: no app-bar Refresh icon-button, so pulling to refresh may be the only way to force a refresh outside of the not-answering state (which has 'Try again', team-board-retry). Flag for gesture-audit.md / a product decision rather than recording an unanswerable gesture-audit row.

TeamHomeScreen.onOpenRun falls back to TeamConversation.open (P0.3, 2026-09-26); only the conversation's own team-page door passes it (to pop back to the same task). onOpenAgent is still never passed.
